title: Blindsee Zugspitzarena
highlights: Turquoise alpine lake perched beneath the Fern Pass at over 1,090 m elevation
World-renowned diving destination famous for sunken trees and 30-meter visibility
Spectacular alpine amphitheater directly beneath the sheer cliffs of the Sonnenspitze
Prime destination for mountain bikers taking on the celebrated Blindsee Trail
kurzbeschreibung: The turquoise Blindsee below the Fernpass is a breathtaking mountain lake and an internationally renowned diving destination.
beschreibung:
Turquoise Natural Jewel Below the Fernpass

The Blindsee lies tucked away in a deep mountain basin below the Fernpass near Biberwier at an altitude of 1,093 metres. Formed by a post-glacial rockslide, this alpine lake mesmerises visitors with its Caribbean-like turquoise waters set against the striking backdrop of the Ehrwalder Sonnenspitze.

Diver's Paradise and Mountain Biking Hotspot

With underwater visibility of up to 30 metres and ghostly sunken tree trunks, Blindsee ranks among the most fascinating diving spots in Central Europe. Hikers and mountain bikers treasure the challenging Blindsee-Trail, which descends from the Fernpass down to the secluded shores.
